title: mymind media slot
description: A frame for a photo, video or screenshot. Filled, it crops its child like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a plain token-tinted surface of the same size and shape, so a layout reads right before the media exists.
notes: size, aspect ratio and radius come from className; on dark cards pass tone="dark"
name: mymind-media

props.name: children
props.description: the image or video; left empty, the slot shows a plain placeholder surface

props.name: tone
props.description: "light" placeholder for pale surfaces, "dark" for dark cards and photo bands

props.name: className
props.description: size, aspect ratio, radius and position of the frame
